data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (open Attractions, enter city, type keyword, search, sort, open result) with the right parameters, but it leaves out the final action (Nearby/favorites) and its parameter, and "Open a result" doesn't say which one, so an automation built from it would be incomplete.
